newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 4.7 pct Nizhnevartovskneftegaz.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 4.7 pct Nizhnevartovskneftegaz.

text.p: Russia will auction 4.7 percent of oil company Nizhnevartovskneftegaz in the form of 861,786 preferred shares on April 28, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said on Friday.
The shares, with a nominal value of 1,000 roubles each, have a starting price of 21,000 roubles ($3.67), putting a value of at least 18.10 billion roubles ($3.16 million) on the stake.
Bids will be accepted from March 26 to April 25, the fund said.
The majority shareholder of AOOT Nizhnevartovskneftegaz, with authorised capital of 18.22 billion roubles, is Tyumenskaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya (TNK).

Preferred shares in Nizhenvartovskneftegaz are currently not traded on the Russian Trading System. The ordinary shares were last traded on March 17 at $8.80. They were quoted on Friday at $8.55/$9.50.
